title: Explain an identical selected unblock when another call commits the clear first
outcome: Explain an identical selected unblock when another call commits the clear first
acceptance: A deterministic two-service same-session test completes an identical keyless selected unblock between another call's missing-core-result read and its clear transaction; the later caller recovers the committed result or receives truthful no-clear guidance without an invented changed-intent/new-key remedy, and no second clear or retirement occurs
Genuine changed-intent explicit-key conflicts retain their refusal semantics and committed selected-unblock recovery remains exact
